name: Silicobra
description: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.description: Sand is hurled in the target’s face, reducing the target’s accuracy.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.description: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

moves.name: Minimize
moves.description: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Glare
moves.description: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

moves.name: Coil
moves.description: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Drill Run
moves.description: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

moves.name: Scale Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user’s Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Poison Tail
moves.description: The user hits the target with its tail. This may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.description: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Belch
moves.description: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
